header: WHO IS IN THE LISTS TODAY (step 65a). I read the roster (public.employee_roster) once for the three lists of the widget: birthdays today, retirements this month, silver jubilees this month. The day is the day in India. The rules are in rules.ts; the SQL below is the same rules, and the tests check the two against each other on thousands of rows. WHAT LEAVES THIS FILE: the name, the designation, the department, the photo address, and for a retirement the farewell day, for a jubilee the anniversary day. NEVER a date of birth or a date of joining. I use the application's own connection here (never the AI search's read-only role).

doc: The photo (the person's `image` in the user table), or null; the card then draws the initials.

members.name: on
doc: Set for a retirement (the farewell day, the last day of the month) and for a silver jubilee (the day the 25th year is completed); empty for a birthday. "YYYY-MM-DD".

symbols.name: safeImageUrl
doc: I trust as a photo only an address that is a web address or a path of this site; anything else (a script, a data address) is not trusted.
